name: multistep_final_warning_harmony
description: Last-turn warning for Harmony/native-tool judges that must return strict JSON matching the judge prompt. Appended as a user message after the tool result. Variables: tool_content, tool_name, stdout, stderr, code, success.

chat_template.content: IMPORTANT: That was your last allowed {tool_name} tool call. Do not call {tool_name} again. Send a final reply that is ONLY a JSON object: {{"feedback": "your concise justification citing the concrete terminal evidence", "label": "the rubric label"}}
